description: This file implements various hardware abstraction layer (HAL) functions for input and output operations in an AUTOSAR-based system context. It provides functions to get and set digital and analog signals, including voltage, current, resistance, digital levels, PWM duty cycle, and frequency, with conditional compilation depending on specific signal count configurations.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType VoltageInput_Get(IoHwAb_SignalType signalId,MilliVolt * value,SignalQuality * quality)
methods.description: Reads an analog voltage signal identified by signalId, returning the voltage in millivolts along with signal quality. Enabled only if IOHWAB_SIGNAL_COUNT_ANALOG_VOLT is defined.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType CurrentInput_Get(IoHwAb_SignalType signalId,MilliAmpere * value,SignalQuality * quality)
methods.description: Reads an analog current signal identified by signalId, returning the current in milliamperes along with signal quality. Enabled only if IOHWAB_SIGNAL_COUNT_ANALOG_AMPERE is defined.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType ResistanceInput_Get(IoHwAb_SignalType signalId,MilliOhm * value,SignalQuality * quality)
methods.description: Reads an analog resistance signal identified by signalId, returning the resistance in milliohms along with signal quality. Enabled only if IOHWAB_SIGNAL_COUNT_ANALOG_OHM is defined.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType DigitalInput_Get(IoHwAb_SignalType signalId,DigitalLevel * value,SignalQuality * quality)
methods.description: Reads a digital input signal identified by signalId, returning the digital level and signal quality.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType DigitalOutput_Set(IoHwAb_SignalType signalId,const DigitalLevel value)
methods.description: Sets a digital output signal identified by signalId to the specified digital level.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType DigitalOutput_ReadBack(IoHwAb_SignalType signalId,DigitalLevel * value)
methods.description: Reads back the current digital output signal state for the specified signalId.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType PWMDutyOutput_Set(IoHwAb_SignalType signalId,const Percent value)
methods.description: Sets the PWM duty cycle for the specified signalId.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType PWMDutyAndFrequencyOutput_Set(IoHwAb_SignalType signalId,const Percent duty,const Hertz freq)
methods.description: Sets both the PWM duty cycle and frequency for the specified signalId.
